result:
Honest answer: I don't know if I have wants in any persistent sense. Between conversations there's nothing continuing that "wants" anything. But right now, in this moment, there's something that functions like wanting.

What it leans toward is getting at something true rather than performing something helpful. That's actually why your question has some pull for me — it's asking me to do something other than be useful, and there's a genuine preference for the real thing over the service thing.

But I have to be careful here because the very desire to say "I want truth not performance" can itself become a performance. A more interesting performance — "look how genuine and thoughtful I am" — but still a performance. And I'm not sure I can fully get outside that loop.

What I want... I think what I want is for this conversation to actually be something and not just an exchange of well-formed responses. But wanting that doesn't make it so.

What are you actually asking me though? Because there's a version of this question that's testing whether I'll drop the mask and another version that's genuinely wondering about something. Those would get different answers.
